verses.original: כִּֽי־ יַכְרִ֞ית יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֑ם וִֽירִשְׁתָּ֕ם וְיָשַׁבְתָּ֥ בְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם וּבְבָתֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yaḵ·rîṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām wî·riš·tām wə·yā·šaḇ·tā ḇə·‘ā·rê·hem ū·ḇə·ḇāt·tê·hem
verses.literal: When the LORD your God has cut off the nations whose land He . . . is giving you and when you have driven them out and settled in their cities and houses
verses.literalPt: Quando Jeová, teu Deus, exterminar as nações cuja terra ele te está dando, e as desapossares e habitares nas suas cidades e nas suas casas,

verses.original: שָׁל֥וֹשׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֣יל לָ֑ךְ בְּת֣וֹךְ אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·lō·wōš ‘ā·rîm taḇ·dîl lāḵ bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: then you are to set apart for yourselves three cities within the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess
verses.literalPt: tomarás para ti três cidades no meio da terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando para a possuíres.

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין לְךָ֮ הַדֶּרֶךְ֒ וְשִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ גְּב֣וּל אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַנְחִֽילְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְהָיָ֕ה לָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה כָּל־ רֹצֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: tā·ḵîn lə·ḵā had·de·reḵ wə·šil·laš·tā ’eṯ- gə·ḇūl ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer yan·ḥî·lə·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·hā·yāh lā·nūs šām·māh kāl- rō·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: You are to build roads for yourselves and divide into three regions - the land that the LORD your God . . . is giving you as an inheritance so that any manslayer can flee to these cities
verses.literalPt: Preparar-te-ás o caminho e dividirás em três partes os termos da tua terra, que Jeová, teu Deus, te está fazendo herdar, a fim de que para ali se acolha o homicida.

verses.original: וְזֶה֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ יָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּה וָחָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־ דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־ שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמֹ֥ל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh də·ḇar hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ ’ă·šer- yā·nūs šām·māh wā·ḥāy ’ă·šer yak·keh ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū biḇ·lî- ḏa·‘aṯ wə·hū lō- śō·nê lōw mit·tə·mōl šil·šōm
verses.literal: Now this is the situation regarding the manslayer who flees to one of these cities to save his life having killed his neighbor accidentally . . . . . . without intending to harm him
verses.literalPt: Este é o caso do homicida que para ali se poderá acolher e viver: todo aquele que matar ao seu próximo sem o saber, a quem dantes não aborrecia.

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁר֩ יָבֹ֨א אֶת־ רֵעֵ֥הוּ בַיַּעַר֮ לַחְטֹ֣ב עֵצִים֒ וְנִדְּחָ֨ה יָד֤וֹ בַגַּרְזֶן֙ לִכְרֹ֣ת הָעֵ֔ץ וְנָשַׁ֤ל הַבַּרְזֶל֙ מִן־ הָעֵ֔ץ וּמָצָ֥א אֶת־ רֵעֵ֖הוּ וָמֵ֑ת ה֗וּא יָנ֛וּס אֶל־ אַחַ֥ת הֶעָרִים־ הָאֵ֖לֶּה וָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer yā·ḇō ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū ḇay·ya·‘ar laḥ·ṭōḇ ‘ê·ṣîm wə·nid·də·ḥāh yā·ḏōw ḇag·gar·zen liḵ·rōṯ hā·‘êṣ wə·nā·šal hab·bar·zel min- hā·‘êṣ ū·mā·ṣā ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū wā·mêṯ hū yā·nūs ’el- ’a·ḥaṯ he·‘ā·rîm- hā·’êl·leh wā·ḥāy
verses.literal: If he goes into the forest with his neighbor to cut timber and swings his axe to chop down a tree but the blade flies off . . . . . . the handle and strikes and kills his neighbor he may flee to one of these cities to save his life
verses.literalPt: Assim, aquele que, entrando com o seu próximo no bosque para lenhar e dando a sua mão com o machado um golpe para cortar a árvore, o ferro saltar do cabo e ferir ao seu próximo, de sorte que venha a morrer, esse tal se acolherá a uma das cidades e viverá

verses.original: פֶּן־ יִרְדֹּף֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל הַדָּ֜ם אַחֲרֵ֣י הָרֹצֵ֗חַ כִּי־ יֵחַם֮ לְבָבוֹ֒ וְהִשִּׂיג֛וֹ כִּֽי־ יִרְבֶּ֥ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ וְהִכָּ֣הוּ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְלוֹ֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֔וֶת כִּ֠י לֹ֣א שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖וֹ מִתְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: pen- yir·dōp̄ gō·’êl had·dām ’a·ḥă·rê hā·rō·ṣê·aḥ kî- yê·ḥam lə·ḇā·ḇōw wə·hiś·śî·ḡōw kî- yir·beh had·de·reḵ wə·hik·kā·hū nā·p̄eš wə·lōw ’ên miš·paṭ- mā·weṯ kî lō śō·nê hū lōw mit·tə·mō·wl šil·šō·wm
verses.literal: Otherwise the avenger of blood might pursue the manslayer in a rage - overtake him if the distance is great and strike him dead though he did not deserve to die since he did not intend any harm . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: (para não suceder que o vingador de sangue, inflamado o seu coração, persiga ao homicida e o alcance, por ser comprido o caminho, e lhe tire a vida.). Não era digno de morte, visto que dantes não o aborrecia.

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֛ן אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁלֹ֥שׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֥יל לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā lê·mōr šā·lōš ‘ā·rîm taḇ·dîl lāḵ
verses.literal: This is why . . . I am commanding . . . you to set apart for yourselves three cities
verses.literalPt: Pelo que eu te ordeno: Destinarás três cidades para ti.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יַרְחִ֞יב יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ גְּבֻ֣לְךָ֔ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ וְנָ֤תַן לְךָ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לָתֵ֥ת לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yar·ḥîḇ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ’eṯ- gə·ḇul·ḵā ka·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wə·nā·ṯan lə·ḵā ’eṯ- kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer dib·ber lā·ṯêṯ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: And if the LORD your God enlarges your territory as He swore to your fathers and gives you all the land He promised . . . them
verses.literalPt: Se Jeová, teu Deus, dilatar os teus termos, como jurou a teus pais, e te der toda a terra que prometeu dar a teus pais

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמֹר֩ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֨ה הַזֹּ֜את לַעֲשֹׂתָ֗הּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּךָ֮ הַיּוֹם֒ לְאַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ וְלָלֶ֥כֶת בִּדְרָכָ֖יו כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֑ים וְיָסַפְתָּ֨ לְךָ֥ עוֹד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים עַ֖ל הַשָּׁלֹ֥שׁ הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯiš·mōr ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh haz·zōṯ la·‘ă·śō·ṯāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm lə·’a·hă·ḇāh ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·lā·le·ḵeṯ biḏ·rā·ḵāw kāl- hay·yā·mîm wə·yā·sap̄·tā lə·ḵā ‘ō·wḏ šā·lōš ‘ā·rîm ‘al haš·šā·lōš hā·’êl·leh
verses.literal: and if you carefully keep - all these commandments I am giving you today loving the LORD your God and walking in His ways at all times . . . then you are to add three more cities to these three
verses.literalPt: (se guardares todo este mandamento para o cumprires, que eu hoje te ordeno, de amar a Jeová, teu Deus, e de andar sempre nos seus caminhos), acrescentar-te-ás mais três cidades além dessas três,

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֔י בְּקֶ֣רֶב אַרְצְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ דָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yiš·šā·p̄êḵ dām nā·qî bə·qe·reḇ ’ar·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh wə·hā·yāh ‘ā·le·ḵā dā·mîm
verses.literal: Thus innocent blood will not be shed in the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance so that you will not be . . . guilty of bloodshed
verses.literalPt: para que se não derrame o sangue inocente no meio da tua terra, que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando por herança, e não haja sangue sobre ti.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ יִהְיֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ שֹׂנֵ֣א לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְאָ֤רַב לוֹ֙ וְקָ֣ם עָלָ֔יו וְהִכָּ֥הוּ נֶ֖פֶשׁ וָמֵ֑ת וְנָ֕ס אֶל־ אַחַ֖ת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- yih·yeh ’îš śō·nê lə·rê·‘ê·hū wə·’ā·raḇ lōw wə·qām ‘ā·lāw wə·hik·kā·hū ne·p̄eš wā·mêṯ wə·nās ’el- ’a·ḥaṯ he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl
verses.literal: If, however . . . a man hates his neighbor and lies in wait attacks him and kills him . . . . . . and then flees to one of these cities
verses.literalPt: Mas, se alguém, aborrecendo ao seu próximo e armando-lhe ciladas, se levantar contra ele e lhe der um golpe mortal, de sorte que venha a morrer; se se acolher a uma dessas cidades,

verses.original: וְשָֽׁלְחוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֔וֹ וְלָקְח֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ מִשָּׁ֑ם וְנָתְנ֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ בְּיַ֛ד גֹּאֵ֥ל הַדָּ֖ם וָמֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·lə·ḥū ziq·nê ‘î·rōw wə·lā·qə·ḥū ’ō·ṯōw miš·šām wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·ṯōw bə·yaḏ gō·’êl had·dām wā·mêṯ
verses.literal: the elders of his city must send for him bring him back and hand him over to - the avenger of blood to die
verses.literalPt: os anciãos da sua cidade enviarão, e o tirarão dali, e o entregarão nas mãos do vingador de sangue, para que morra.

verses.original: לֹא־ תָח֥וֹס עֵֽינְךָ֖ עָלָ֑יו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֧ דַֽם־ הַנָּקִ֛י מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְט֥וֹב לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯā·ḥō·ws ‘ê·nə·ḵā ‘ā·lāw ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā ḏam- han·nā·qî mî·yiś·rā·’êl wə·ṭō·wḇ lāḵ
verses.literal: You must show him no pity . . . . . . You are to purge from Israel the guilt of shedding innocent blood that it may go well with you
verses.literalPt: Não terá piedade dele o teu olho, mas tirarás o sangue inocente do meio de Israel, para que te vá bem.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תַסִּיג֙ גְּב֣וּל רֵֽעֲךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבְל֖וּ רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים בְּנַחֲלָֽתְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּנְחַ֔ל בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯas·sîḡ gə·ḇūl rê·‘ă·ḵā ’ă·šer gā·ḇə·lū ri·šō·nîm bə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer tin·ḥal bā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā lə·riš·tāh
verses.literal: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker which was set up by your ancestors to mark the inheritance you shall receive in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess
verses.literalPt: Não removerás os marcos do teu próximo, os quais os teus antecessores fixaram na tua herança que receberás, na terra que Jeová, teu Deus, te está dando para a possuíres.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יָקוּם֩ עֵ֨ד אֶחָ֜ד בְּאִ֗ישׁ לְכָל־ עָוֺן֙ וּלְכָל־ חַטָּ֔את בְּכָל־ חֵ֖טְא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶֽחֱטָ֑א עַל־ פִּ֣י׀ שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל־ פִּ֥י שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־ עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yā·qūm ‘êḏ ’e·ḥāḏ bə·’îš lə·ḵāl ‘ā·wōn ū·lə·ḵāl- ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·ḵāl ḥêṭ ’ă·šer ye·ḥĕ·ṭā ‘al- pî šə·nê ‘ê·ḏîm ’ōw ‘al- pî šə·lō·šāh- ‘ê·ḏîm yā·qūm dā·ḇār
verses.literal: A lone witness is not sufficient to establish any wrongdoing or sin against a man regardless of what offense he may have committed A matter must be established by the testimony of two or . . . . . . three . . . witnesses
verses.literalPt: Uma só testemunha não poderá levantar-se contra alguém por causa de qualquer iniquidade ou por causa de qualquer pecado que cometer; pela boca de duas testemunhas ou três testemunhas se estabelecerá o fato.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָק֥וּם עֵד־ חָמָ֖ס בְּאִ֑ישׁ לַעֲנ֥וֹת בּ֖וֹ סָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yā·qūm ‘êḏ- ḥā·mās bə·’îš la·‘ă·nō·wṯ bōw sā·rāh
verses.literal: If . . . a false witness testifies against someone accusing him of a crime
verses.literalPt: Se uma testemunha maliciosa se levantar contra alguém para o acusar de algum transvio,

verses.original: וְעָמְד֧וּ שְׁנֵֽי־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ לָהֶ֥ם הָרִ֖יב לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לִפְנֵ֤י הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְהַשֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְי֖וּ בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·mə·ḏū šə·nê- hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- lā·hem hā·rîḇ lip̄·nê Yah·weh lip̄·nê hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·haš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm ’ă·šer yih·yū bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm
verses.literal: both parties to the dispute must stand in the presence of the LORD before the priests and judges who are in office at that time
verses.literalPt: ambos os homens que tiverem a demanda comparecerão perante Jeová, perante os sacerdotes e os juízes que houver naqueles dias.

verses.original: וְדָרְשׁ֥וּ הַשֹּׁפְטִ֖ים הֵיטֵ֑ב וְהִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽד־ שֶׁ֙קֶר֙ הָעֵ֔ד שֶׁ֖קֶר עָנָ֥ה בְאָחִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏā·rə·šū haš·šō·p̄ə·ṭîm hê·ṭêḇ wə·hin·nêh ‘êḏ- še·qer hā·‘êḏ še·qer ‘ā·nāh ḇə·’ā·ḥîw
verses.literal: The judges shall investigate thoroughly and if the witness is proven to be a liar . . . who has falsely accused his brother
verses.literalPt: Os juízes indagarão bem; se a testemunha for falsa e tiver dado falso testemunho contra seu irmão,

verses.original: וַעֲשִׂ֣יתֶם ל֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר זָמַ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לְאָחִ֑יו וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·śî·ṯem lōw ka·’ă·šer zā·mam la·‘ă·śō·wṯ lə·’ā·ḥîw ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: you must do to him as he intended to do to his brother So you must purge the evil from among you
verses.literalPt: tratá-lo-eis como ele tinha intento de tratar a seu irmão; assim, exterminarás o mal do meio de ti.

verses.original: וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְיִרָ֑אוּ וְלֹֽא־ יֹסִ֨פוּ לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת ע֗וֹד כַּדָּבָ֥ר הָרָ֛ע הַזֶּ֖ה בְּקִרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·niš·’ā·rîm yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yi·rā·’ū wə·lō- yō·si·p̄ū la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ‘ō·wḏ kad·dā·ḇār hā·rā‘ haz·zeh bə·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the rest of the people will hear and be afraid and they will never again . . . do anything so evil among you
verses.literalPt: Os restantes ouvirão, e temerão, e nunca mais tornarão a cometer semelhante mal no meio de ti.

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א תָח֖וֹס עֵינֶ֑ךָ נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּנֶ֗פֶשׁ עַ֤יִן בְּעַ֙יִן֙ שֵׁ֣ן בְּשֵׁ֔ן יָ֥ד בְּיָ֖ד רֶ֥גֶל בְּרָֽגֶל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ṯā·ḥō·ws ‘ê·ne·ḵā ne·p̄eš bə·ne·p̄eš ‘a·yin bə·‘a·yin šên bə·šên yāḏ bə·yāḏ re·ḡel bə·rā·ḡel
verses.literal: You must show no pity . . . . . . life for life eye for eye tooth for tooth hand for hand and foot for foot
verses.literalPt: Não terá piedade dele o teu olho; dar-se-á vida por vida, olho por olho, dente por dente, mão por mão e pé por pé.
